prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high-endurance performance with carbohydrate loading and pre/post-workout nutrition timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly one full day with 4-5 meals/snacks
Total daily calories support high-endurance athlete needs (approximately 3000+ kcal)
Carbohydrates comprise 55-65% of total calories with strategic timing around training
Includes specific meal timing recommendations relative to workout sessions
task_description: Write acompact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading with specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle gain and strength development with optimal protein distribution for recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Protein is distributed across meals (minimum 25-35g per meal) totaling approximately 2.0-2.2g per kg of body weight
Includes specific timing of carbohydrates and micronutrients (iron, magnesium, zinc) around training to support muscle synthesis and recovery
Meals are concise and practical for a weightlifter's schedule
task_description: Write acompact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution across meals and micronutrient timing for recovery and muscle synthesis

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain energy and performance for soccer training (10am) and evening match (7pm) with optimal recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals/snacks strategically timed around 10am training and 7pm match
Macronutrient balance emphasizes carbohydrates for sustained energy with adequate protein for recovery
Includes hydration guidance appropriate for match day demands
All meals comply with vegetarian and dairy-free restrictions
